connector.name: Qnexus MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Quantinuum Nexus, wrapping the qnexus SDK. Not affiliated with Quantinuum.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package qnexus-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the blite-hq account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: QNEXUS_MCP_MAX_CREDITS
env.description: Hard per-call HQC ceiling; 0 blocks all spend (default: 0).

env.name: QNEXUS_MCP_MAX_OUTCOMES
env.description: Top-N cap on distinct measurement outcomes returned per result item (default: 100).

env.name: QNEXUS_MCP_MAX_SUBMISSIONS_PER_MINUTE
env.description: Sliding-window submission cap; each circuit in a batch counts as one (default: 6).

env.name: QNEXUS_MCP_PROJECTS
env.description: Comma-separated project allowlist, enforced on every mutating tool (default: all projects).
